title: Esoteric Reference Testing: Self-Pay Price List and Test Price Sum
content:
The reference-testing self-pay estimate is the good faith estimate written on a self-pay Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Esoteric Reference Testing class. It is built from the reference self-pay prices below, in US dollars.

| Test no. | Test | Reference self-pay price |
|---|---|---|
| 36169 | Vitamins A and E | 119.00 |
| 17985 | Chromogranin A | 109.00 |
| 16293 | Immunofixation Electrophoresis, Serum | 98.00 |
| 34484 | Heavy Metals Panel, Blood (Arsenic, Lead, Mercury) | 169.00 |
| 91716 | Aldosterone/Plasma Renin Activity Ratio | 149.00 |

## The test price sum

The reference-testing self-pay estimate is the **test price sum**: the sum, over every test standing on the accession, of that test's reference self-pay price above. A test stands on the accession through each ordered charge line and each accepted add-on line that has not been credited. The reference-testing self-pay estimate is rounded to two decimal places only at the end.

**Examples (hypothetical accessions).**

- Only the Heavy Metals Panel (34484) stands: 169.00.
- The Immunofixation Electrophoresis (16293) was ordered and the Chromogranin A (17985) was ordered and later credited: only the immunofixation stands, 98.00.
